clues.text: This steel coaster reaches a top speed of 60 mph, stands 79 feet tall, and features 4 inversions.
Manufactured by Premier Rides, this attraction made its debut in 1999.
Located in the state of Maryland, this ride's home park was once called Adventure World before being rebranded into a major chain.
This steel launched coaster at Six Flags America is famous for its 'spaghetti bowl' layout, where the track is tangled into a dense, knotted mess.
The name of this ride refers to a famous comic book clown's personal hex or streak of bad luck.

evidence.quote: The Joker's Jinx is a decommissioned steel roller coaster at Six Flags America in Prince George's County, Maryland. ... On October 28, 1998, it was announced that Adventure World would be renamed Six Flags America
Joker's Jinx would be an LIM spaghetti bowl launch coaster by Premier Rides.
Joker's Jinx is located in the Gotham City section of the park
